guidelines.detail: refines FID-01 (The description explicitly says the secretary selects one of the offers, supporting a distinct selection activity. This refines the general instruction to model every stated activity. The reference task also mentions placing an order, which the description does not state, so that additional action is not part of this guideline.)

documentation rule FID-03 not applied (The label pairs show semantic shifts or generic wording, while the description provides the actions and decision context needed for faithful labels. FID-03 already advises using short, faithful labels.)

refines LANE-01 (The description assigns work to several internal roles (S1, S5, S6), while also describing interaction with outside companies (S3). The missing lanes are supported by C2, C5, and C17. The extra pool and message flow (C22, C23) are not treated as missing elements; the guideline clarifies how to model internal responsibilities when external participants are also present.)

refines GW-06 (The description supports a required activity alongside condition-dependent work, and the reference gateways have no counterpart in the generated model. This makes GW-06’s inclusive split/join guidance more specific to a required branch combined with an optional one. The description does not support treating every concurrent activity as part of these same branches.)

new guideline (The description distinguishes branches by shipment circumstances, while the generated gateway label refers to a different decision. The existing documented and learned guidelines returned do not already state this gateway-labeling rule.)

same as LRN-026 (The description explicitly says that offers are requested from outside companies and one is selected. That supports a distinct external interaction; the generated participant and message flows are not omissions to correct. The guideline is already captured by LRN-026.)

same as LRN-038 (The description distinguishes inviting companies to make offers from selecting one, while the generated task represents receiving offers rather than the selection. This matches learned guideline LRN-038.)

same as LRN-039 (The description says the secretary invites the companies to make offers, but does not describe their activities or response. The generated model adds a pool and message flow for them, which the reference does not contain. This is already covered in substance by LRN-039, which says to model an outside participant separately only when the description establishes independent communication.)

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that a participant selects one option from multiple offers or alternatives: Model the selection as an explicit activity performed by that participant; do not represent the selection only through a gateway or route condition.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that a participant selects one option from multiple offers or alternatives

rules_sent_back.instruction: Use short, faithful labels in the input language. Prefer verb-object activity names and meaningful business triggers or outcomes for events.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states an activity or decision whose action or outcome can be identified from the stated wording

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description assigns work to multiple internal roles or departments within one process and also describes interaction with an outside participant: Model the internal responsibilities as lanes within the same process pool; model the outside participant separately only when the description establishes independent communication.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description assigns work to multiple internal roles or departments within one process and also describes interaction with an outside participant

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that an activity is required while another activity may be performed only if a stated condition holds, and that the flow continues after the applicable work is complete: Model the activities as branches from an inclusive split, with the condition on the optional branch, and use an inclusive join to synchronize the branches that were activated before the dependent next step.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that an activity is required while another activity may be performed only if a stated condition holds, and that the flow continues after the applicable work is complete

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states a condition that distinguishes alternative branches: Label the gateway with the branch-controlling condition stated in the description, rather than with a separate downstream decision or activity.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states a condition that distinguishes alternative branches

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that one participant requests information or action from another participant and that the other participant provides a response: Model the request and response as a connected interaction: use sequence flows within a participant’s process and message flows between distinct participant pools, rather than an unrelated detached start-to-end chain.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that one participant requests offers or information from an outside party and receives a response

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description identifies multiple required activities within a phase, requires all of them before that phase can end, and specifies no order among them: Model the activities as parallel branches synchronized by a parallel gateway.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says that one activity can proceed while other work is underway and that a later activity depends on both paths being ready
